Flooding has been reported on the main road with water rising quickly. The system assesses a moderate severity, noting potential road closures and vehicle hazards. No people at risk have been mentioned.

- Flooding on the main road (reported)
- Water is rising quickly (reported)

## 2. What was observed in the image
No image was provided.

- Without instructions during sudden intense flooding with rising water, do not travel through water and move to an upper floor. (entry FL-12, chunk en/flood_kb.md::section::6)
No guidance available in the knowledge base for this point. Follow the instructions of the authorities and emergency services.

## 4. System assessment
Severity: moderate. Evidence: Flooding on the main road with water rising quickly reported (report); no people at risk mentioned (report). Main risks include potential road closure, vehicles becoming stranded or swept away, and spread of floodwater to adjacent areas (report). Possibly affected elements are the main road, vehicles traveling on or near the road, and nearby properties or infrastructure (report).

## 5. Missing information and uncertainties
Uncertainties: No image was analysed.
Information needed: Water depth; Flow rate or rate of rise; Extent of flooding (how far it spreads); Number of people or vehicles affected; Whether evacuation has started; Whether any injuries or casualties have occurred.
